item.title: Drug trio found to block tumour resistance in pancreatic cancer
item.description:
📝 Researchers at the Spanish National Cancer Research Centre have announced a potential breakthrough combination therapy that induces complete regression of pancreatic tumours and prevents tumour resistance in preclinical models. These results should guide the development of new clinical trials that may benefit PDAC patients.
